content.text:
Done. Here's a summary of everything that was changed:

**Critical fix:**
- [hyperdrive.ts](packages/deploy-cloudflare/src/db/hyperdrive.ts) — `max: 5` → `max: 1`. Each request creates a new pool that's never explicitly closed; a pool of 5 would exhaust Hyperdrive connection slots under any concurrency.

**Module split** — `api.ts` (526 lines) → 5 focused files:
- [env.ts](packages/deploy-cloudflare/src/worker/env.ts) — `Env` interface + `resolveDeploymentMode()`, eliminating 3 duplicate inline ternaries
- [route-registry.ts](packages/deploy-cloudflare/src/worker/route-registry.ts) — all 22 route imports, `buildRequestResources()`, path regex cache, and `CompiledRoute` type
- [upload-handlers.ts](packages/deploy-cloudflare/src/worker/upload-handlers.ts) — R2 upload endpoints in a `registerUploadHandlers(app)` function
- [app.ts](packages/deploy-cloudflare/src/worker/app.ts) — Hono app, setup gate middleware, catch-all router
- [api.ts](packages/deploy-cloudflare/src/worker/api.ts) — thin entry point (~100 lines): `fetch`, `queue`, `scheduled`, DO/Workflow re-exports; removed dead `getCompiledRoutes` wrapper and unused `skillsService`/`instructionsService`

**Supporting fixes:**
- [heartbeat-sweep.ts](packages/deploy-cloudflare/src/cron/heartbeat-sweep.ts) — `Env` import updated to `env.ts`
- [node-fs.ts](packages/deploy-cloudflare/src/shims/node-fs.ts) — removed duplicate `notAvailableSync` (identical to `notAvailable`)
- [node-fs-promises.ts](packages/deploy-cloudflare/src/shims/node-fs-promises.ts) — added `lstat`, `watch`, `pipeline` to default export
- [.gitignore](packages/deploy-cloudflare/.gitignore) — protects `dist/` and `.dev.vars` from accidental commits
- [.dev.vars.example](packages/deploy-cloudflare/.dev.vars.example) — documented template for local dev secrets
- [wrangler.toml](packages/deploy-cloudflare/wrangler.toml) — `compatibility_date` bumped to `2025-03-01`; unimplemented cron jobs no longer emit console noise

All 8 previously-passing routes verified working after the refactor.
